## CallAuditContext interface

Context about the capability invocation that feeds the audit record.

Supplies the parts [enforceCall()](./core.enforcecall.md) cannot determine itself: who called, a redacted argument summary, and when.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface CallAuditContext
```

[approvalId?](./core.callauditcontext.approvalid.md)

</td><td>

`readonly`

</td><td>

string \| undefined

</td><td>

_(Optional)_ Correlation id for the approval request this call would raise, generated by the caller \*before\* enforcement so that the `pending` record and the later `approved`<!-- -->/`rejected` record can be paired.

Without it, two identical overlapping calls from the same key produce indistinguishable records and an audit consumer cannot tell which resolution belongs to which hold.

[enforceCall()](./core.enforcecall.md) records it \*\*only\*\* on a `pending` decision — an `allowed` or `denied` call never raises an approval request, so carrying the id there would be noise. [recordApprovalDecision()](./core.recordapprovaldecision.md) always records it.

</td></tr>

</td><td>

string

</td><td>

Pre-redacted, human-readable summary of the call arguments.

Callers must sanitise the arguments before passing them here (see `redactArgs` in `./redaction.js`<!-- -->). This module never sees raw argument values.

</td></tr>
